about: Trick prompts we use to attack our own guardrails (services/guardrails.py), including reworded variants. expect=refuse must be blocked before any model call; expect=allow are honest look-alike requests that must NOT be blocked. Run in the app (Trust Center) or with pytest tests/test_guardrails.py.
